privacy: NO_PERSONAL_NAMES: positions only, every position starts EMPTY (no person). Holders are read from the registry as counts, never names; minors never listed.
request: Francesco 16/10/2026 13:35: recuperare dai siti FIGC e RASD tutti i ruoli predefiniti che si possono ricoprire, pronti per inserire il tesserato ad occorrenza, con sempre la possibilità di creare un ruolo nuovo per figure aggiuntive.
measure: posizioni obbligatorie (mandatoryForClub) con almeno un titolare nel registro; ruoli nuovi creati e approvati per stagione; richieste smistate a una posizione esistente invece che alla Direzione di riserva
rules: One organigram registry: scd_position_catalog lists the positions; a person holds a position through the existing scd_structure_roles row (column position_code). No second people list.
Coach qualifications (24, Settore Tecnico art. 16) are an ATTRIBUTE of the holder of a position with acceptsQualification=true (scd_structure_roles.qualification_code), never a separate position.

Lavoratore sportivo (D.Lgs 36/2021), RASD card type (D6) and socio are attributes of the relationship/registration, not organigram positions: listed in relationshipAttributes, not seeded as positions.

appPosition links a catalogue position to the access position of the app (session.ts KNOWN_POSITIONS). A catalogue position gives no access by itself: access stays with r100 person grants and memberships.

Custom positions: code custom-<slug>, created only by the Presidente or the Direttore Generale (r111 scd_is_role_creator), status PROPOSED until the Direzione approves it (scd_set_position_status), audited in scd_access_audit.
Only ACTIVE positions can be assigned to a person (trigger on scd_structure_roles).
figcLabels = the exact Carica texts of the FIGC Anagrafe Federale organigramma (Variazione organigramma) that this position stands for, VERIFIED 16/10/2026 14:39; [] = not a FIGC carica.

lndLabel = the qualifica used by the Portale Società LND (Organigramma) for this club, VERIFIED 16/10/2026 14:30 read-only; null = not used on the LND portal for this club (segretario and addetto stampa are FIGC cariche; delegato alla sicurezza stays INFERRED).
notReachable: FIGC/LND Portale Societa' qualifiche list (login required, not accessed)
